title: PinkOrBlue – Virtual Gender Reveal Party & Boy or Girl Poll
meta_desc: Share one link, let family and friends vote boy or girl and make their guesses, then reveal it live on every screen at once. Free, no sign-up, no ads.
hero_sub: Open a room, share the link with family and friends, and let everyone cast their vote. When you hit reveal, the big moment lands on every screen at the very same second, so Grandma across the country and your best friend overseas are right there with you.
hero_note: No sign-up, no app, no ads.
how_h2: Three steps to a moment you'll never forget
steps: Name your party, pick the date and enter the result. It stays hidden from guests until you start the reveal.
Drop it in the family group chat, a text or an e-mail. Guests tap the link, type their name and vote Team Pink or Team Blue. Everyone sees who has voted and who is still missing.
When everyone's in, start the reveal. The countdown runs, the animation plays, and pink or blue, everyone finds out at the same moment.
feats_h2: Everything your reveal needs, in one link
feats: Every guest floats in as a golden balloon. You can see who is here right now and who still has to vote.
Votes stay secret until the big moment
Nobody sees the score before the reveal, so the suspense holds. Then everyone finds out who guessed right, name by name. Aunt Linda's "it's a girl, I just know" is on the record.
At the reveal, everyone taps their screen to inflate one giant balloon together. When it pops, the answer appears on every screen in the same second.
Alongside their vote, guests leave their predictions. After the reveal, you'll see who called it.
A mini game for the wait
While everyone waits for the big moment, guests compete in a mini game and the top score shows up in the room.
No accounts, no ads, no tracking. Room data deletes itself 7 days after the party, or sooner if you delete it yourself.
faq_home: We keep only what the party needs: the room details, the names guests type in, their votes and guesses, and mini-game scores. We never ask for an e-mail, phone number or password, and there are no ads, analytics or tracking cookies. The privacy policy has the details.
Everything in a room is deleted automatically 7 days after the party date. The host can also delete the room at any time before that.
Yes, completely free. No hidden fees, no subscription and no ads.
PinkOrBlue is designed for a family-and-friends crowd of around 30 people, so you can comfortably invite your whole circle.
Can family who live far away join?
Absolutely, that's what PinkOrBlue is for. Anyone in another city or country can join the same room from the link and watch the reveal at the same second you do.
By default the host enters it. The host can also hand the secret to a trusted guest, so the host is surprised along with everyone else. Guests can't see the result until the reveal starts.
Do we need to download an app?
No. PinkOrBlue runs in the browser on any phone, tablet or computer. Guests just tap the link and type their name; no sign-up needed.
Can several families use it at the same time?
Yes. Each family opens its own room with its own link. Rooms are completely separate, so votes and results never show up in anyone else's party.
